@@U04145@@
(A camp follower, sidling up to him.)

@@U04146@@
Although his wife I may not be, He's the dearest of men to me. What a harvest, what a catch! Women are regular fiends when they snatch! They plunder and rifle, they're ruthless, you'll see! All’s fair in war! On to victory!

@@U04147@@
(Exeunt both.)

@@U04149@@
As expected, their right flank’s attacking our left in full force. We must resist to the last man their desperate attempt to take the narrow pass.

@@U04151@@
(Pointing to the one at the left.)

@@U04152@@
If you please, sir, take this man, too. It never hurts to add to your strength.

@@U04154@@
(Stepping forward.)

@@U04155@@
The left wing's safe, dismiss all care! No need for worry once I am there. The old one still has all his wits; What this hand grasps, no lightning splits.

@@U04156@@
(Exit. )

@@U04158@@
(Descending from above.)

@@U04159@@
Look behind you there! You see? Men, hordes of them, thronging from every rocky gorge and ravine, overwhelming every narrow path in our rear, helmets, armor, shields, and swords forming a wall of strength not to be broken. Behold them straining to strike.
translation:
@@U04145@@
（一名营地追随者，侧身靠近他。）

@@U04146@@
虽然我可能不是他的妻子，但他是我最亲爱的男人。多么的收获，多么的收获！女人一旦抢夺，就是恶魔！他们掠夺和步枪，他们是残酷的，你会看到的！战争中一切都是公平的！走向胜利！

@@U04147@@
（两者都退出。）

@@U04149@@
果然，他们的右翼正在全力攻击我们的左翼。我们必须抵抗他们拼命夺取狭窄通道的企图。

@@U04151@@
（指着左边的那个。）

@@U04152@@
如果您愿意的话，先生，请把这个人也带走吧。增加你的力量总是没有坏处的。

@@U04154@@
（向前迈出一步。）

@@U04155@@
左翼安全，不用担心！一旦我到了那里，就不用担心了。老者神智尚存，此手所握之物，无雷电劈裂。

@@U04156@@
（退出。）

@@U04158@@
（从上往下。）

@@U04159@@
看看你身后那儿！你看？成群结队的人，从每一个岩石峡谷和沟壑中涌来，压倒了我们后方的每条狭窄道路，头盔、盔甲、盾牌和剑形成了一道坚不可摧的力量之墙。看他们竭尽全力地攻击。
